permit.first: an employment contract or job offer and, as a rule, the employer's municipal permit to employ foreign labour for the job

fees.what: Processing fee (SIRI states 'No fee' for the residence and work permit)

permit.pay: Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Greenlandic standards. This means that your salary, holiday entitlements, terms of notice etc. must not be inferior to the standards within the professional field in which you are going to work.

exempt.note: Not for performers: SIRI's exemption for a stay shorter than 3 months covers 'a professional athlete or artist (excluding performers, restaurant musicians and similar)', so it may reach a director or screenwriter but an actor needs the permit from the first day.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Work in Greenland
sources.said: Normal processing time 3 months If further information is needed, the processing time can be up to 6 months … Processing fee No fee … you must apply for a residence and work permit at the Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI), which will process the application based on an approval from the Government of Greenland . … As a rule, your employer must have a municipal permit that allows them to employ foreign labour for the job in question in order for you to work in Greenland. … a professional athlete or artist (excluding performers, restaurant musicians and similar), … Your salary and terms of employment must correspond to Greenlandic standards. This means that your salary, holiday entitlements, terms of notice etc. must not be inferior to the standards within the professional field in which you are going to work. … When you apply, you must attach a copy of your employment contract or job offer. … A residence permit in Greenland can be granted with a validity of up to 2 years from the date a decision is made in your case. … You can work in Greenland without holding a work permit if your stay is shorter than 3 months, and you are: a researcher or a lecturer who has been invited to teach or lecture in Greenland, a professional athlete or artist (excluding performers, restaurant musicians and similar),

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Work in Greenland - extension
sources.said: You can apply for an extension of your residence and work permit in Greenland if there has not been made changes to your employment. … You can submit an application for an extension of a residence and work permit no sooner than 2 months before your permit expires, and no later than the last date your permit is valid for.

note: SIRI processes the residence and work permit on the Government of Greenland's approval; as a rule the employer first needs the municipality's permit to employ foreign labour for the job, and the permit runs no longer than that municipal permit, at most two years from the decision. No fee. Terms must meet Greenlandic standards and the job is normally full-time. The three-month exemption for artists excludes performers, so no exempt days.
